objectives: Explain why the notary is a private professional who performs state functions.
List the main duties of the notary towards the parties, with the article for each.
Describe the bodies of the Notary Chamber and what each one does.
Explain the civil and disciplinary liability of the notary and the role of insurance.
Say what happens to the archive when a notary loses the capacity.

cards.front: Is the state liable for the acts of a notary?
cards.back: **No** (Art. 73(2) ЗННД). The notary is liable, up to the certified material interest, and must be insured.

cards.front: Upper limit of the notary's civil liability?
Whose faults does the notary's insurance cover?
cards.back: Those of the notary, the **assistant notary** and the **employees** (Art. 30(1) ЗННД).

cards.front: Can a notary act outside the district?
cards.back: **No.** Such an act is null (Art. 573(1) and 576 ГПК).

cards.front: When may a notary refuse to deal with a request?
cards.back: When the notary has an interest in the act or a special relation with the party that raises a well-founded doubt about impartiality (Art. 23 ЗННД).

cards.front: What must the parties declare about the price in a sale of real estate?
cards.back: That the amount in the deed is the **payment actually agreed** (Art. 25(9) ЗННД).

cards.front: How are payments over 10,000 leva in real estate deals made?
cards.back: Through the **special bank account of the notary** or a bank account in a bank chosen by the parties (Art. 25(10) ЗННД).

cards.front: Can creditors of the notary seize money in the special account?
What does the notary check at the National Revenue Agency before a sale of real estate?
cards.back: That the transferor has **no unpaid public debts subject to enforcement** (Art. 264(1) ДОПК).

cards.front: Name the four bodies of the Notary Chamber.
cards.back: General Assembly, Council of Notaries, Control Council, Disciplinary Commission (Art. 52 ЗННД).
Reprimand; fine of 1,000–5,000 лв.; warning of deprivation; deprivation of capacity for 3 months to 5 years (Art. 75 ЗННД).
**Six months** after discovery, and at most **two years** after the breach (Art. 76(1) ЗННД).

cards.front: Where is a disciplinary decision appealed, and when?
cards.back: Before the **Supreme Court of Cassation** within **14 days** (Art. 80 ЗННД).

cards.front: What happens to the archive when a notary loses the capacity?
cards.back: It is **sealed** by order of the president of the district court, with an inventory, and handed over (Art. 36 ЗННД).

quiz.question: A seller says to the notary: "You work for me, I chose you." What is the correct position?
options: The notary is impartial and does not take sides
The notary represents the party who pays the fee
The notary represents the buyer
The notary represents the seller
quiz.explanation: The notary may not take sides in the performance of the functions.

quiz.question: A party asks the notary for a meeting without the other relatives present. What does the law say?
options: The notary meets the person alone unless the person wants others present
The notary must always have a witness
All relatives have the right to attend
Only a lawyer may attend
quiz.explanation: Meeting alone is a rule that protects people under pressure.

quiz.question: A buyer pays 80,000 euro in a sale of an apartment. How may the price be paid?
options: Through the special bank account of the notary or a bank account in a bank chosen by the parties
In cash in front of the notary
In cash if both parties agree
Only by a cheque
quiz.explanation: Payments over 10,000 leva in such deals go through the notary's special account or a bank account.

quiz.question: What must the notary check before an act, under Art. 25(2) ЗННД?
options: Whether a security measure under the law on illegally acquired assets is imposed
The credit score of the buyer
The salary of the seller
The market price of the property
quiz.explanation: Art. 25(2) requires a check for security measures under the law on the forfeiture of illegally acquired assets.

quiz.question: The check at the National Revenue Agency shows that the seller has unpaid public debts subject to enforcement. What is possible?
options: The deal can proceed after payment, or if the seller agrees in writing that the debts are paid from the price and the buyer pays them into the budget
The deal can never proceed
The deal proceeds and the notary pays the debt
The deal proceeds without any condition
quiz.explanation: Art. 264(4) ДОПК gives these two options.

quiz.question: What is the maximum civil liability of a notary for a deed with a price of 120,000 euro?
options: Unlimited
The amount of the fee
The insured amount only
quiz.explanation: The notary is liable up to the certified material interest.

quiz.question: Who decides a disciplinary case against a notary at first instance?
options: A panel of the Disciplinary Commission of the Notary Chamber
The district court
The Minister of Justice
The General Assembly
quiz.explanation: The chair of the Disciplinary Commission appoints a panel of three.

quiz.question: A breach was committed in March 2024 and discovered in January 2026. Can a disciplinary penalty still be imposed?
options: No, because two years from the breach ended in March 2026
Yes, within six months from January 2026
Yes, at any time
Only with the consent of the Minister
quiz.explanation: The limit is six months from discovery and at most two years from the breach. Two years from March 2024 ended in March 2026.

quiz.question: Who may take an original document out of the notary's archive for an expert examination?
options: Only on a written order of a judge or prosecutor, and the expertise is made in the notary's presence
Any police officer
Any party to the deed
The Notary Chamber at any time

quiz.question: Within what time must a notary report a change of the office address to the register?
options: Seven days
One month
Three days
There is no time limit
quiz.explanation: Persons in the register report changes within seven days; the president of the district court is informed at once.

quiz.question: Which statement about the special bank account is correct?
options: A written agreement between the notary and the parties sets the conditions for paying in and paying out
The money belongs to the notary until the deed is entered
Creditors of the notary may seize it
It may be used only for cash payments
quiz.explanation: Art. 25а(2) requires a written agreement; Art. 25а(3) protects the money from the notary's creditors.

quiz.question: What happens to a notary's archive after the notary dies?
options: It is sealed with an inventory and handed over to another notary or the registration judge
The family keeps it
It is destroyed after one year
The Notary Chamber sells it
quiz.explanation: Art. 36–38 ЗННД govern the sealing and handing over of the archive.
